title: Cross-account invoice disclosure
description: A regular user can request an invoice belonging to another account because the API checks authentication but does not check invoice ownership.
exploitation_steps: In the authorized test environment, create accounts A and B and an invoice for B.
Authenticate as A and request B's invoice ID from GET /api/invoices/{id}.
Observe that the response contains B's invoice despite A having no shared membership or invoice permissions.
impact: A regular user can read another account's billing address and invoice line items.
evidence: Fixture: A is in tenant-a; B and invoice inv-b are in tenant-b; no shared membership exists.
Request: GET /api/invoices/inv-b with A's session. Response: HTTP 200, {invoice_id: inv-b, tenant_id: tenant-b, billing_address: [test address], line_items: [test items]}.
Handler excerpt: require_authenticated_user(request); return db.invoices.get(invoice_id). No ownership check is performed.

context.environment: Synthetic example in an authorized test environment
context.intended_policy: Invoices are private to their tenant
context.known_mitigations: None observed in the test handler
